stewards.name: Visa
stewards.role: Writes the specification and Product Terms, onboards agents, hosts the key store and signs the ID Token.

implementers.name: Cloudflare
implementers.role: Development partner (co-developed TAP with Visa) and edge verifier; planned Agents SDK support and managed rules (announced 2025-10-24).

implementers.name: Akamai
implementers.role: TAP support across Akamai Cloud (announced 2025-12-17); Visa named Akamai among the providers supporting live merchant implementation on 2026-07-02.

implementers.name: lastminute.com, Frasers, Cleverbridge, BrickDepot
implementers.role: Merchants in Visa's live European agent transactions (2026-07-02).

implementers.name: eDreams ODIGEO (eDreams, Opodo, GO Voyages, Travellink)
implementers.role: Said it is using TAP and the Agentic Directory to recognize verified agents (2026-07-03, secondary report).

implementers.name: Worldpay
implementers.role: Acquirer that announced collaboration with Visa and Cloudflare on TAP at launch.

implementers.name: Launch feedback partners
implementers.role: Adyen, Ant International, Checkout.com, Coinbase, CyberSource, Elavon, Fiserv, Microsoft, Nuvei, Shopify, Stripe and Worldpay gave feedback; not a list of deployments.

implementers.name: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect
implementers.role: Visa on-ramp that accepts agent payments initiated through TAP, MPP, ACP and UCP.

implementers.name: mppx (Tempo, wevm)
implementers.role: MPP SDK with a TAP attestation signer and verifier.

sdks.name: mppx
sdks.note: MIT; mppx/attestation/tap signs and verifies TAP attestations. Not a Visa package. Version as of 2026-10-21 (published 2026-10-21).

sdks.name: @visa/cli
sdks.note: Visa Crypto Labs CLI under Visa's own license. Release candidates from 5.0.0-rc.335 (2026-09-18) sign TAP requests; the latest release, 4.0.1, does not. Version as of 2026-10-19.

sdks.name: mpp-card
sdks.note: Visa's MPP card SDK under Visa's own terms.

sdks.name: visa/trusted-agent-protocol (sample code)
sdks.note: Python and Node.js sample, no published package; last commit 2025-10-28.

sdks.name: visa/ai workspace packages (@visa/api-client, @visa/mcp-client, @visa/token-manager)
sdks.note: VIC clients, not published on npm as of 2026-10-19.

metrics.metric: Merchants named as live with TAP
metrics.definition: Merchants Visa named in its live European agent transactions.
metrics.caveat: No total count of verifying merchants is published (Visa newsroom and developer pages, 2026-10-19).

metrics.metric: European issuers with live agent purchases
metrics.definition: Issuers named in Visa's release; the text says over 30.
metrics.caveat: VIC program metric, not TAP traffic.

metrics.definition: Visa's own description of completed agent transactions.
metrics.caveat: Self-reported VIC figure; named transactions are pilots or first transactions.

metrics.metric: Partners working with Visa on agentic commerce
metrics.definition: Visa said over 30 build in the VIC sandbox and over 20 agents and enablers integrate directly.
Visa internal data on bot-initiated transactions.

metrics.metric: AI-driven traffic to US retail sites
metrics.definition: Adobe year-over-year figure for July 2025 (published August 2025), cited in Visa's launch release of 2025-10-14.
metrics.caveat: Adobe figure quoted by Visa; month-level date only.

costs.value: None stated in the Product Terms
costs.caveat: The license is revocable, and Visa can change the specification at any time; implementers must apply each update within six months.

costs.value: Free in sandbox; production fees on request from Visa
costs.caveat: No public production price. Read live on 2026-10-11; since October 2026 Visa's VIC developer pages require sign-in, so the cited copy is the archive of 2026-10-03.

costs.whoPays: No agent-specific fee published; ordinary acquiring fees apply as far as published
costs.caveat: Evidence of absence from Visa's pages and two secondary reviews. Visa's public rules (since 2025-10-18) set no agent-specific fee, and its April 2026 US interchange schedule has no agentic category; treat agent purchases as ordinary tokenized card-not-present payments until Visa publishes otherwise.

costs.value: Cloudflare's signed-agent field needs an Enterprise plan with Bot Management; no TAP-specific price
costs.caveat: Plan pricing is not public. The field covers Web Bot Auth agents; Cloudflare does not document whether TAP verifications set it.
